East Zone, led by Ishan Kishan, also features Mohammed Shami and Mukesh Kumar.  Sooryavanshi's inclusion as vice-captain drew considerable attention to his red-ball challenge.
title: Back-to-back fours, then out! Sooryavanshi falls cheaply in Duleep Trophy - Watch

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Prime Minister Modi met with India's space startups, praising their ambition and energy.  National Space Day celebrates Chandrayaan-3's successful landing on the Moon's south pole.  This achievement marks India's significant progress in space exploration and scientific innovation.  ISRO Chairman Narayanan recalled humble beginnings and highlighted global data sharing.  The day aims to inspire greater interest in science and technology for all.
title: ‘Impressed by their energy & ambition’: PM Modi meets India’s space startups

author: DEVANSHI MEHTA
description: Three Delhi Police officers were injured during a patrol in Mukundpur.  They were attacked with chilli powder, bricks, and sticks by a group.  This confrontation occurred after police seized a motorcycle lacking valid documents.  One 17-year-old juvenile was apprehended, while other attackers fled the scene.  Authorities are actively searching for the main absconding accused, Sunil alias Pankaj.
title: Delhi cops attacked with bricks, sticks, chilli powder during patrol; teen held

author: AARAV DENGLA
description: The Mechanical Turk first appeared in 1770 as a chess-playing machine that astonished audiences across Europe and the Americas. It played Benjamin Franklin and Napoleon Bonaparte, but the secret was a skilled chess player hidden inside its cabinet. Despite widespread suspicion, the illusion endured for decades. Its story offers a striking reminder that the impression of an autonomous mind can hide the reality behind it.
title: Before AI, there was the Mechanical Turk: The chess machine that wasn’t

title: Iowa couple turns abandoned fire station into dream family home

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Michigan woman gives birth in Uber, driver returns as baby’s godmother

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'Why this abnormal gap?' Cong questions delay in prorogation of Monsoon Session

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Awarapan 2 continues to hold strong as it heads into its second weekend, with the film showing renewed strength through its second week after settling into a steady weekday rhythm. Emraan Hashmi's sequel has comfortably outpaced its Independence Day rivals and shows no signs of slowing down meaningfully, adding healthy sums on both Day 8 and Day 9. Here's a live look at how Day 10 is shaping up.
title: 'Awarapan 2' BO Day 10: Emraan Hashmi sequel targets Rs 130 crore India net

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: ‘Silent guardian’: Rahul cast as ‘real-life batman’ in posters outside Congress HQ

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In his memoir Play Nice But Win, Michael Dell recalls meeting Steve Jobs in the spring of 1980 at a Houston computer user group, aged just fifteen. Jobs, then 25 and weeks from Apple's IPO, spoke about personal computers revolutionising the world. Dell writes he was riveted, and could not have imagined that in five years, Steve Jobs and he would be colleagues and friends, long before their famous Apple rivalry.
title: 'I was fifteen and riveted': What Steve Jobs said that hooked a young Michael Dell

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Daughter of MLA Rohit Pawar's PA found dead in Maharashtra's Baramati; cops launch probe

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Emotions ran high as Yashasvi Jaiswal and Asitha Fernando clashed following the dismissal of the Indian opener. Fernando's exuberant celebration sparked a fiery exchange, necessitating the intervention of the Sri Lankan captain to defuse the situation. By the end of the morning session, India found themselves at 88/2 after winning the toss, maintaining a lead of 1-0 in the two-match Test series following their previous win.
title: Ugly scenes! Jaiswal, Fernando clash after heated send-off in Colombo - Watch

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In a significant turn of events, Canada has halted trade negotiations with the United States due to unresolved disagreements. Three critical demands from the US regarding Canada's auto industry and trade agreements proved too contentious. Additionally, restrictions concerning language and culture were deemed unacceptable. As a result, both nations are now enacting retaliatory tariffs on each other's products.
title: US FTA proposal: What are the '3 American demands' that became deal breaker for Canada

author: VRITI JAIN
description: A tragic scene unfolded at Khavdya Dongar when a teenager jumped to his death, despite his mother's heartfelt pleas, where she knelt in an attempt to save him. Villagers and police labored for over three hours to reach him, but as his father tried to pull him back, calamity struck, resulting in the loss of both parents during this devastating fall.
title: Maha hill tragedy: New video shows mother kneeling before son, begging him to step back

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ravindra Jadeja reached a remarkable milestone on Sunday by playing his 50th World Test Championship match, becoming the first Indian cricketer to achieve this feat. In the Colombo Test, India announced a change in their lineup, with Saransh Jain receiving his debut cap from Jadeja. The Indian team won the toss and opted to bat first, setting the stage for an exciting match.
title: Ravindra Jadeja creates history, becomes first Indian to achieve this feat

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'India could use water as weapon': Pak minister as IWT remains in abeyance

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Mount Trashmore Park in Virginia Beach serves as a unique example of transformation, evolving from a large landfill into a vibrant 165-acre recreational area. Opening its gates in 1973, this park now boasts serene lakes, extensive trails, and playgrounds, showcasing innovative landfill reclamation practices. Its picturesque setting attracts visitors who appreciate the blend of nature and community space, highlighting the benefits of repurposing land.
title: Garbage hill in Virginia Beach became America's first landfill park

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Delhi-NCR twins Naina and Nayantara Singh developed a plant-based water purification system. Their innovation, Aqua Sattva, uses okra, fenugreek, and rice husk to remove contaminants. This system targets microplastics and PFAS, often called forever chemicals. Independent laboratory testing showed significant removal efficiency for these pollutants. The affordable and eco-friendly prototype aims to make safe drinking water more accessible.
title: Delhi-NCR twins build Rs 100 water filter that removes up to 93% of PFAS

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mitchell Starc's extraordinary performance saw him take ten wickets, leading Australia to an emphatic innings win over Bangladesh. Securing victory by an innings and fifty-one runs in the second Test, Australia equalized the two-match series. Starc’s final statistics read ten wickets for fifty-one runs, while Bangladesh struggled significantly, being dismissed for sixty-four and ninety-five across their two innings.
title: Starc’s 10-wicket haul powers Australia to series-levelling win over Bangladesh

author: HADI KHAN
description: A Bengaluru customer was upset by a cafe's bill description. The receipt identified him as "Little Fat Black Shirt" instead of his name. Subko cafe has apologized publicly for the incident and its team member's actions. They are taking accountability and condemning body-shaming in all its forms. The cafe has invited feedback through its Internal Complaints Commission.
title: 'Little fat black shirt': Bengaluru cafe faces heat over 'body-shaming' customer

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In a significant turn of events, Canada has halted trade discussions with the United States due to last-minute demands deemed unreasonable. In retaliation, President Donald Trump has reignited his '51st state' comments while imposing tariffs. The US negotiation team mentioned that Canada declined to accept a tariff reduction proposal on critical products.
title: ‘Canada wants benefits of being State’: Trump's 1st reaction after trade talks collapse

author: ANURAG BENDE
description: Rahul Gandhi addressed women students, criticizing a patriarchal mindset and Prime Minister Modi's reaction. He stated that the fight is against a system that restricts women's freedom. Gandhi invoked Manusmriti, asserting women belong only to themselves. He highlighted that examination paper leaks affect women differently due to marriage pressures. The Congress leader invited students to share their experiences of harassment and educational challenges.
title: No problem with boys but PM gets ‘cultural shock’ if girls use cuss words: Rahul

author: ROUSHAN ALI AND SRIBALA VADLAPATLA
description: The Centre withheld permission for Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy's US visit.  This decision came after reports of planned political meetings with US leaders emerged.  The ministry stated the proposed program was inappropriate for the CM's official visit.  Revanth Reddy is currently in the United Kingdom, meeting educational institutions.  His deputy called the denial of permission unfortunate and politically motivated.
title: Revanth planned to meet Vance, Mamdani on US trip MEA denied nod to

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: During a recent event, actor Yash expressed his gratitude towards the Telugu audience, emphasizing the expanding influence of cinema. He highlighted that talent and diligence transcend language barriers, fostering unity among viewers. Yash inspired students to aim high and accept their failures, encouraging the youth to rise above regional differences in the film industry. His much-anticipated project, 'Toxic', is scheduled for release on August 26.
title: Yash sends a strong message on ‘North-South’ comparison at ‘Toxic’ pre-release event

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: Toddler dies after 'severe beating'; 18-year old mother, boyfriend arrested in Georgia

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Saransh Jain celebrated a significant breakthrough on Sunday by making his Test debut for India at 33, facing off against Sri Lanka. With more than a decade's worth of domestic experiences behind him, Jain's impressive red-ball track record led to this noteworthy selection, making him the first Indian player to debut after turning 33 since 1998.
title: Saransh Jain makes India debut at 33: Who is the allrounder taking on Sri Lanka?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Salons' discarded human hair has found a new life as pollution-absorbing mats. These innovative mats intercept contaminants in drains, preventing them from entering larger water bodies. Utilizing the natural oil-absorbing properties of keratin in hair, the HydroHair Barrier System has shown promise in pilot tests, leading to reductions in key pollution indicators.
title: Gurugram founder turns salon hair waste into mats that clean polluted water

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Chicken chain co-founder restores 3,000-acre Texas ranch, revives lost springs

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: National Space Day: PM Modi hails India’s space journey, salutes Chandrayaan-3 success

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Saransh Jain has stepped onto the field, marking his Test debut for India in the second match against Sri Lanka. With Kuldeep Yadav sidelined by a viral infection, the captain, Shubman Gill, opted to bat first after winning the toss on a favourable pitch. Following a commanding win in the opener, India seek to build on their 1-0 series lead, while also addressing areas for growth in their performance.
title: Why Kuldeep Yadav is not playing 2nd Test vs Sri Lanka: What Gill and BCCI said

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: After battling cancer for over a decade, Subodh Jain finally watched his son Saransh make his India debut in the second Test against Sri Lanka in Colombo. From wanting to quit cricket to becoming a domestic stalwart, Saransh's journey has been shaped by his father's resilience, Chandrakant Pandit's belief and years of perseverance.
title: 'I fought cancer to see my son play for India': Saransh's long road to Test cricket

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: Reddy denied US visit, Gujarat CM cleared: Overseas Congress alleges ‘double standard’

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Shoriful Islam achieved a historic seven-wicket haul against Australia in the second Test. His exceptional bowling figures of 7/48 marked a significant achievement for Bangladesh cricket. Australia secured a first-innings lead of 146 runs after being bowled out for 210. Earlier, Mitchell Starc's six-wicket haul had restricted Bangladesh to just 64 runs. Bangladesh face a challenging task to avoid defeat.
title: Shoriful Islam makes history with record seven-wicket haul against Australia

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Govinda, the celebrated actor, has taken a stand against false and defamatory content in a public notice. This alert focuses specifically on AI-generated images and misleading reports about his family. Emphasizing that no one has permission to manipulate his identity, he has threatened civil and criminal proceedings against those who violate these stipulations, aiming to combat the rampant spread of misinformation and rumors online.
title: Govinda issues notice against defamatory content amid spat with wife Sunita Ahuja

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
title: 40% of India's office occupiers worry about finding quality space through 2028

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In its ninth day of release, Batwara 1947 managed to earn Rs 1.15 crore, bringing its total net collection in India to Rs 35.50 crore. Additionally, the film's overseas earnings accounted for Rs 9.00 crore, resulting in a global gross of Rs 51.12 crore. Unfortunately, the film directed by Rajkumar Santoshi did not achieve the expected success at the box office.
title: Batwara 1947: Sunny Deol film crosses Rs 51cr worldwide amid clash with Awarapan 2

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Indian-American Congressman Shri Thanedar and colleagues oppose ICE's electric shock glove plan.  They warn of potential misuse and severe injury or death from these devices.  Lawmakers cite ICE's past record and insufficient training for officers.  The proposed procurement involves millions of dollars for thousands of gloves.  They implore the Homeland Security Secretary to immediately stop this purchase.
title: ‘Could result in injury or death’: Thanedar urges halting ICE’s electric shock glove plan

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Portugal secured a cricket victory over Spain, avenging their football World Cup defeat.  The Portuguese team won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Europe Sub Regional Qualifier C.  This triumph keeps Portugal's dream of reaching the 2028 T20 World Cup alive.  Spain's chase faltered after Portugal posted a competitive total of 160 runs.  Portugal's bowlers delivered a strong performance to secure the 57-run win.
title: Portugal get their revenge on Spain — this time in cricket — after WC heartbreak

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft Learn has told students on X that learning to code is worth it "now more than ever", even as AI writes a growing share of software. Satya Nadella says AI already produces up to 30% of Microsoft's code, while Google puts its figure at 75%. The skill has not died, it has shifted from writing syntax to reviewing, debugging and directing AI-generated code.
title: Microsoft has a 6-word answer for students wondering if coding is still worth it

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Canada has halted trade negotiations with the United States due to perceived inequities in demands, leading to the US imposing hefty tariffs on Canadian exports. In response, Canada has unveiled countermeasures to address these tariffs. Prime Minister Carney criticized the US for its unreasonable requests while providing insufficient concessions. This escalation raises alarms about the future of economic collaboration between the two nations.
title: 'Masters in our own home': Canada PM Carney explains why talks with US were suspended

author: ABHAY
description: A software engineer died after an argument over household chores escalated. His wife and her brothers allegedly attacked and strangled him at his home. The victim's family members were also assaulted during the violent altercation. Police have arrested four individuals in connection with the software engineer's death. Investigations are ongoing into the matrimonial disputes which preceded the incident.
title: ‘Who would apply medicine to child’s blisters?’: Delhi techie killed over chore; wife, in-laws held

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'Conveyed our security concerns to US': Israel on Hamas disarmament plan

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is reportedly planning to leave his position by late 2026.  This departure follows months of reported tension with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.  Driscoll's exit could leave the Army without a Senate-confirmed leader.  The Army also currently lacks a Senate-confirmed chief of staff.  These developments signal significant changes at the Pentagon's senior levels.
title: Amid tensions with Hegseth, US Army secy Dan Driscoll to step down by year-end

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: ‘Wrong-side’ driving trend: 12 deaths in Britain, Ireland linked to social media buzz

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: With over eight crore Indian youth facing unemployment, a lack of vital skills hampers their job prospects. Financial barriers restrict many students from accessing crucial paid training programs, while graduates frequently settle for low-paying positions to assist their families financially. There is a stark career mismatch, as only a fraction of graduates find appropriate roles, making subsidized training and earn-as-you-learn opportunities essential for career advancement.
title: No work, no study, no training: 8.7 crore Indian youth caught in a career gap

author: ASHISH CHAUHAN
description: A 56-year-old Gujarati man was fatally shot during a liquor store robbery. The gunman demanded cash and then fired multiple shots inside the premises. His 19-year-old daughter stood beside him but remained unharmed during the incident. Another employee suffered a fractured wrist after falling during the shooting. Police are actively searching for the unidentified suspect and his vehicle.
title: Gujarat store owner shot dead in US in front of 19-year-old daughter

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Years before their eventual divorce, Tom Brady openly discussed a difficult period in his marriage to Gisele Bündchen. In a 2020 interview with Howard Stern, Brady said Bündchen felt he was not doing enough for their family while he focused heavily on football and business. Her concerns forced him to reassess his priorities, and the couple sought counseling. Brady also revealed that he kept a heartfelt letter from Bündchen as a reminder.
title: Tom Brady reveals heartbreaking moment Gisele Bündchen said she was unhappy

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes has praised his wife Brittany Mahomes for helping transform women’s sports in Kansas City. As a founding co-owner of the Kansas City Current, Brittany helped turn her lifelong soccer passion into a larger movement, supporting investment in female athletes and the development of CPKC Stadium. Patrick called her a “driving force” behind the team’s rise, highlighting how her vision has created opportunities and inspired young girls across the city.
title: Patrick Mahomes reveals Brittany’s key role in transforming women’s sports

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In the early hours of Sunday, eastern Japan experienced a moderate earthquake, with injuries reported for over twenty individuals, primarily minor. The strong tremors caused significant disruptions in transportation services, including train delays across the region. A water pipe burst was noted in Tokyo, alongside power outages affecting numerous homes. Fortunately, no tsunami threat emerged, and nuclear facilities remained secure.
title: 5.9 earthquake rattles Japan: 23 injured, trains disrupted; no tsunami threat

author: MAHIYAR PATEL
description: The Cockroach Janta Party's school audit campaign encountered resistance in Mumbai. A headmaster filed a complaint against CJP members inspecting Colaba Market Civic School. Auditors noted deficiencies like absent teachers and poor sanitation facilities. The organization is now cautious about further school inspections in the city. CJP continues volunteer recruitment and training meetings across Navi Mumbai and Mumbai.
title: CJP’s audit faces pushback as Mumbai civic school files plaint

author: SHISHIR ARYA
description: Pakistani brides arrived in India through special air travel arrangements. These journeys facilitated marriages after land borders remained closed for a long time. Many families accompanied the brides, returning within the allowed visa period. The Shadaani Darbar in Sindh played a crucial role in enabling these marriages. Around 300 more girls are currently awaiting similar opportunities to marry.
title: Sindoor finds a way across border as 150 Pakistan brides arrive for weddings

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Awarapan 2 has taken the box office by storm, crossing the landmark of one hundred crore rupees. After a remarkable surge in earnings on its ninth day, the film's total net collection in India now stands at one hundred twenty-seven point five zero crore. Additionally, overseas collections have played a significant role in boosting its overall global revenue. This action-packed sequel follows the footsteps of the beloved 2007 movie Awarapan.
title: Awarapan 2 Day 9: Emraan Hashmi film tops Rs 180cr worldwide despite Batwara 1947 clash

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has reached an incredible milestone in football by scoring in twenty-five consecutive league seasons. This unprecedented achievement highlights his enduring talent, having maintained an unbroken scoring streak that dates back to the 2002-03 season. With a career total of nine hundred seventy-seven goals, he remains focused on reaching the remarkable one thousand goal mark in his illustrious career.
title: Ronaldo becomes first player in the Football history to achieve unprecedented feat

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Trump shares image calling Hormuz 'new US territory'; Iran says strait 'closed'

author: SANJEEV DEVASIA
description: Two individuals died and five others sustained injuries when a large Ganpati idol collapsed during its procession. The idol fell due to an apparent welding issue with its supporting frame, police officials stated. The incident occurred late Saturday night as the procession neared its destination in Bhuleshwar. The deceased included the Ganpati mandal president, Sanket Nevshe. Investigations into the exact circumstances of the accident are currently underway by authorities.
title: Ganpati idol falls during procession in Mumbai; 2 dead, 5 injured
